lemmas.statement: For a literal physical crossing block with order-two volume E2>0, arbitrary same-bank phases and cap-one product inputs satisfy sup_a E|Q-a|^(-1/2) <= 8*2^(3/8)*E2^(-1/8).
proof: Sharp product marginals give a d-dimensional linear image cap 2^(d/2)/sqrt(det(LL^T)).
For p>=2, int |fhat|^p <=4pi/sqrt(p): take m=floor(p/2)>=p/4, identify the 2m power with the density at zero of m independent differences, and use the sharp one-dimensional projection cap.
Insert these two constants into the source grouped compiler at q=2.
After literal row-promotion losses, the three envelopes min(1,B/|t|) have B<=pi*2^(7/4)E2^(-1/4), pi*2^(5/4)E2^(-1/4), and 2pi E2^(-1/4).
The Riesz weighted integral is 8sqrt(B)/sqrt(2pi), giving coefficients 8*2^(3/8), 8*2^(1/8), and 8; the first is largest.
